title: Kissed Savory Polish Pork Dumplings
description: Briny and bouncy Polish dish featuring shaoxing wine, perfect for a cozy dinner, this recipe dehydrates certain ingredients for a dash of friendly flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the ground pork, shaoxing wine, chopped onion, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper, mixing well with your hands or a wooden spoon until just combined.
Rehydrate the dehydrated mushroom by soaking it in hot water for a few minutes, then chop it finely and add it to the pork mixture, mixing again until just combined.
Lay a dumpling wrapper on a flat surface and place a tablespoon of the pork mixture in the center of the wrapper.

Dip your finger in a small amount of water and run it along the edge of the wrapper, then fold the wrapper into a triangle by bringing the two opposite corners together to form a point, pressing the edges together to seal the dumpling.
Repeat the process with the remaining wrappers and filling.
Place the dumplings on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving some space between each dumpling to allow for even cooking.
Brush the tops of the dumplings with a little bit of oil.
Bake the dumplings in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, then serve hot.
